charts.execution_plan: Phase 3 corrected protocol; deterministic execution followed by verification against the original claim.
charts.design_concerns: Pausing prevents adaptation but does not remove external degradation; control false-positive rate is 100%.
charts.design_changes: Replaced the always-firing toy gate with the SDK recent-window quality rule (100 decisions, q<0.75) and routed paused cases to a fixed human-review control.
charts.actual_value: Conservation improves post-change quality by +3.12 to +28.59pp across four degradation streams (100 trials; seed 42)
charts.notes: Phase 3 result; no parameter tuning to the expected value.
charts.phase3_fix: Replaced the always-firing toy gate with the SDK recent-window quality rule (100 decisions, q<0.75) and routed paused cases to a fixed human-review control.

charts.execution_plan: Phase 3 corrected protocol; deterministic execution followed by verification against the original claim.
charts.design_concerns: The no-degradation control also transitions, invalidating status as a specific degradation signal.
charts.design_changes: Calibrated status transitions against a clean control using the SDK recent-window quality threshold.
charts.actual_value: Clean control remains GREEN (0% false positives); degraded streams transition to PAUSED with class-dependent timing (100 trials; seed 42)
charts.notes: Phase 3 result; no parameter tuning to the expected value.
charts.phase3_fix: Calibrated status transitions against a clean control using the SDK recent-window quality threshold.

charts.execution_plan: Phase 3 corrected protocol; deterministic execution followed by verification against the original claim.

charts.execution_plan: Phase 3 corrected protocol; deterministic execution followed by verification against the original claim.

charts.notes: Phase 3 result; no parameter tuning to the expected value.
charts.phase3_fix: Removed clean-stream false positives with the SDK recent-window gate and evaluated four degradation classes without tuning the threshold per class.

charts.execution_plan: Phase 3 corrected protocol; deterministic execution followed by verification against the original claim.

charts.phase3_fix: Computed Spearman and Kendall directly on true and learned factor values instead of correlating argsort index arrays.

charts.execution_plan: Phase 3 corrected protocol; deterministic execution followed by verification against the original claim.

charts.phase3_fix: Replaced the toy loop with existing five-copilot real K-learning outputs and measured decision utility as routing quality times action accuracy.

design_concerns_found: Phase 1 jm_experiment_map.json was absent; the 23-chart manifest was reconstructed from extracted runners and the paper specification.
Several protocols encode the expected relationship into synthetic data generation.
E-JM-1 and E-JM-3 arm comparisons are not fully paired.
E-JM-4 has a 100% no-degradation false-positive rate and conservation harms accuracy.
E-JM-4b uses full centroid reset rather than the paper's stated 15% retention.
E-JM-5 computes Spearman and Kendall on order arrays rather than rank vectors.
E-JM-6 approved scope is zero, making its c=1.139 combined-metric fit unidentifiable.
E-JM-6b reports a degenerate zero-width bootstrap interval.
E-JM-7's separate-store comparator is code-identical to the global arm.
A calibrated SDK-style recent-window gate detects sparse 10% adversarial events in only 57% of trials.
Real five-copilot K-learning utility grows sub-linearly (c=0.643) despite a +21.96pp final advantage.
The combined utility-scope exponent point estimate exceeds one, but deployment-bootstrap uncertainty crosses one.

Paired personnel-change and transfer arms on identical streams.
Replaced the E-JM-4 toy gate with the SDK recent-window quality rule and a clean specificity control.
Corrected value-based rank statistics for E-JM-5.
Replaced the E-JM-6 toy loop with existing real five-copilot K-learning outputs.
Implemented independent and hierarchical entity stores for E-JM-7.
Made FIGURE-2 observations action-conditioned and centroid updates cell-specific.
